stories.summary: Ukraine has called for tighter sanctions against Russia following drone attacks that resulted in the closure of several bridges in Kyiv, causing significant traffic disruptions. At least one person was reported killed in the assaults, which have intensified the ongoing conflict between the two nations.

stories.title: New Pentagon Office of Religious Affairs Established by Pete Hegseth
stories.summary: Pete Hegseth has established a new Office of Religious Affairs at the Pentagon, which will report directly to him. This move is part of his leadership approach that emphasizes his evangelical Christian beliefs, including hosting worship services for Pentagon employees.

stories.title: Ethiopia and Eritrea Cut Diplomatic Ties Amid Tigray Conflict Escalation
stories.summary: Ethiopia has severed diplomatic ties with Eritrea, accusing it of supporting the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF), which has been launching attacks into Ethiopia's Afar and Amhara regions. As part of this diplomatic fallout, Ethiopia announced the expulsion of 10 Eritrean diplomats and the closure of its embassy in Asmara. In response, Eritrea has also cut all diplomatic ties with Ethiopia following these developments.

stories.title: Widespread Student Protests Lead to School Closures in France
stories.summary: Around 400 schools have been closed across France due to ongoing student protests, which have resulted in approximately 2,000 arrests and numerous injuries. The unrest has prompted calls from ministers for a 'day of dialogue,' while students are planning further strike actions.
